h.gu: 3.1.1 Size સાચું,તો પણ Fit કેમ નહિ?

body.en:
Start with a situation

A shaft can satisfy a diameter limit and still bend;the hole may be correctly sized but poorly oriented.

Definition

Dimensional tolerance is the permitted size variation.Geometrical tolerance controls specified form,orientation,location or run-out of a feature.

Understand the reason

Read the drawing standard,feature specification,datum system and any modifiers together.Size alone does not define every geometrical requirement.

Example / application

A straightness check and a diameter check answer different questions.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Do not turn a surface-comparator reading into a full geometrical acceptance claim without a defined method.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

Shaft diameter limitમાં હોય છતાં વાંકો હોઈ શકે;holeનું size સાચું પણ orientation ખોટું હોઈ શકે.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Dimensional tolerance માન્ય size variation છે.Geometrical tolerance featureની આપેલી form,orientation,location કે run-outને નિયંત્રિત કરે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Drawing standard,feature specification,datum system અને modifiers સાથે વાંચો.ફક્ત sizeથી દરેક geometrical requirement નક્કી નથી થતી.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Straightness check અને diameter check જુદા સવાલોના જવાબ આપે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Defined method વગર surface-comparator readingને full geometrical acceptance ન કહો.

body.en:
Definition

Basic size is the reference size;upper/lower limits are the permitted extreme sizes.Tolerance=upper−lower limit.

Deviation is the algebraic difference from basic size.Unilateral tolerance lies on one side;bilateral tolerance lies on both sides,not necessarily equally.

Allowance is the intentional minimum clearance or maximum interference at maximum-material sizes;using a signed-clearance convention,A=Dmin−dmax.

Example / application

A shaft20.000to20.020mm has tolerance.020mm and deviations0,+.020mm from basic20mm.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A tolerance width is nonnegative;a signed deviation or allowance can be negative.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Basic size reference size છે;upper/lower limits માન્ય extreme sizes છે.Tolerance=upper−lower limit.

Deviation એટલે basic sizeથી signed difference.Unilateral tolerance એક બાજુ હોય;bilateral બન્ને બાજુ હોય,જરૂરી નથી કે સરખી હોય.

Allowance એ maximum-material sizes પર ઇરાદાપૂર્વકની minimum clearance કે maximum interference છે;signed-clearance conventionમાં A=Dmin−dmax.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Shaft20.000થી20.020mmનું tolerance.020mm અને basic20mmથી deviations0,+.020mm છે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Tolerance width negative નથી;signed deviation કે allowance negative હોઈ શકે.

h.en: 3.1.3 Three fits and the limit-system idea

body.en:
Definition

Clearance fit never has interference over the specified limits;interference fit never has clearance;transition fit can produce either.

For holeD and shaftd:Cmin=Dmin−dmax;Cmax=Dmax−dmin.Negative clearance denotes interference.

Understand the reason

In a hole-basis system the hole fundamental deviation has its lower limit at basic size for anH hole;choose shafts for different fits.In a shaft-basis system anh shaft has its upper limit at basic size;choose holes.

An ISO fit designation combines basic size,hole/shaft fundamental-deviation letters and tolerance grades.Use the correct standard tables for numerical limits.

Remember / avoid this mistake

AnH7 hole andh6 shaft designation is not itself a universal numerical tolerance independent of diameter range.

Quick check: Which is MMC:small hole or large hole?

The smallest permitted hole contains the most material;the largest permitted shaft is its MMC.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Specified limitsમાં clearance fitમાં interference નથી;interference fitમાં clearance નથી;transition fitમાં બન્ને શક્ય છે.

Hole D અને shaft d માટે:Cmin=Dmin−dmax;Cmax=Dmax−dmin.Negative clearance એટલે interference.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Hole-basis systemમાં H holeની lower limit basic size પર હોય;જુદા fits માટે shafts પસંદ કરીએ.Shaft-basisમાં h shaftની upper limit basic size પર હોય;holes બદલીએ.

ISO fit designationમાં basic size,hole/shaft fundamental-deviation letters અને tolerance grades આવે.Numerical limits માટે યોગ્ય standard tables જોઈએ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

H7 hole અને h6 shaftનું numerical tolerance diameter rangeથી સ્વતંત્ર એક જ આંકડો નથી.

જાતે વિચારો: MMCમાં નાનું Hole કે મોટું?

સૌથી નાનું permitted hole સૌથી વધુ material રાખે;shaft માટે સૌથી મોટું permitted size MMC છે.

body.en:
Given

Hole30.000–30.025mm;shaft29.980–29.995mm.

Stepwise solution

  1. Hole tolerance=.025mm;shaft tolerance=.015mm
  2. Cmin=30.000−29.995=.005mm
  3. Cmax=30.025−29.980=.045mm;allowance=+.005mm
  4. Both clearances are positive:clearance fit.For a second shaft30.010–30.035mm with the same hole,Cmin=−.035mm,Cmax=+.015mm:transition fit.

Remember / avoid this mistake

For an interference example with shaft30.030–30.045mm,Cmin=−.045mm,Cmax=−.005mm:interference magnitudes range.005–.045mm.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Hole30.000–30.025mm;shaft29.980–29.995mm.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Hole tolerance=.025mm;shaft tolerance=.015mm
  2. Cmin=30.000−29.995=.005mm
  3. Cmax=30.025−29.980=.045mm;allowance=+.005mm
  4. બન્ને clearance positive:clearance fit.એ જ hole સાથે બીજો shaft30.010–30.035mm હોય તો Cmin=−.035mm,Cmax=+.015mm:transition fit.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Shaft30.030–30.045mm હોય તો Cmin=−.045mm,Cmax=−.005mm:interference magnitude.005–.045mm.

body.en:
Definition

Straightness of a surface line is assessed against a specified straightness zone;it is a form control and normally needs no datum.

Construction:parts and purpose

A qualified straight reference or calibrated angle/displacement system defines the method.

Supports hold the part without unwanted distortion.

An indicator or optical sensor samples the intended line.

A sampling/reduction plan specifies spacing and reference removal.

Working:sequence and reason

Identify the drawing feature and relevant tolerance zone.

Clean,support and align the part along the line.

Collect readings at specified locations with a stable reference.

Reduce reference tilt/shape according to the method and compare the line error with the zone.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A straightedge light gap is a useful qualitative check,but is not automatically a numerical certified straightness result.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Surface lineની straightness આપેલા straightness zone સામે તપાસીએ;તે form control છે અને સામાન્ય રીતે datum જરૂરી નથી.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Qualified straight reference કે calibrated angle/displacement system method આપે.

Supports અનિચ્છિત distortion વગર part પકડે.

Indicator/optical sensor જરૂરી line sample કરે.

Sampling/reduction plan spacing અને reference removal નક્કી કરે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Drawing feature અને tolerance zone ઓળખો.

Part સાફ કરી line પ્રમાણે support/align કરો.

Stable referenceથી નક્કી સ્થાનોના readings લો.

Method મુજબ reference tilt/shapeની અસર કાઢી line errorને zone સાથે સરખાવો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Straightedge light gap ગુણાત્મક check છે,આપમેળે numerical certified straightness result નહિ.

body.en:
Definition

Flatness confines the whole surface between two parallel planes separated by the specified tolerance;no datum is required for the form specification.

Construction:parts and purpose

A stable reference plate and calibrated probing system support comparison.

Appropriate supports avoid bending the part.

A grid or specified paths cover the surface.

A reduction method removes setup tilt and evaluates the zone.

Working:sequence and reason

Define the surface and an adequate sampling pattern.

Stabilise the part and check reference quality.

Measure distributed points,not merely one edge.

Evaluate the two-plane zone by the specified method and assess sampling/uncertainty.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Raw maximum−minimum includes setup tilt unless appropriately referenced/reduced;finite points may miss local defects.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Flatnessમાં આખી surfaceને tolerance જેટલા અંતરવાળા બે parallel planesમાં રાખવી પડે;form specification માટે datum જરૂરી નથી.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Stable reference plate અને calibrated probing system comparison આપે.

યોગ્ય supports part વાંકો થતો અટકાવે.

Grid કે આપેલા paths surfaceને cover કરે.

Reduction method setup tilt કાઢી zone evaluate કરે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Surface અને પૂરતું sampling pattern નક્કી કરો.

Part stable કરી reference quality તપાસો.

ફક્ત એક edge નહિ,ફેલાયેલા points માપો.

Specified methodથી two-plane zone તપાસી sampling/uncertainty જુઓ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

યોગ્ય reference/reduction વગર raw maximum−minimumમાં setup tilt આવે;ઓછા points local defects ચૂકી શકે.

body.en:
Definition

A circular cross-section must lie between two concentric circles separated radially by the stated roundness tolerance.

Construction:parts and purpose

A precision roundness machine supplies a characterised rotation axis.

A radial probe senses the selected cross-section.

Centring/levelling fixtures align the part.

Software or analysis chooses the specified reference circle/filter.

Working:sequence and reason

Clean,mount and select the required axial sections.

Centre/level while controlling spindle and fixture effects.

Record the radial profile for a full rotation.

Apply the stated reference-circle/filter method and report the radial zone.

Remember / avoid this mistake

V-block/dial checks are useful screening but depend on lobing/support angle and setup;TIR is not universally equal to roundness error.Diameter variation is also not the same quantity.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Circular cross-section tolerance જેટલા radial અંતરવાળા બે concentric circlesમાં આવવો જોઈએ.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Precision roundness machine characterised rotation axis આપે.

Radial probe પસંદ કરેલો cross-section માપે.

Centring/levelling fixtures part align કરે.

Analysisમાં specified reference circle/filter લેવાય.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Clean/mount કરી જરૂરી axial sections લો.

Spindle/fixture effects નિયંત્રિત કરી centre/level કરો.

આખા rotationનો radial profile નોંધો.

આપેલી reference-circle/filter methodથી radial zone report કરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

V-block/dial screening ઉપયોગી છે પણ lobing,support angle,setup પર આધારિત છે;TIR હંમેશાં roundness error નહિ.Diameter variation પણ જુદી quantity છે.

body.en:
Definition

Squareness checks90° orientation;perpendicularity is a datum-related geometrical control with the drawing-defined zone.

Construction:parts and purpose

A qualified square/reference or CMM establishes90° relative to the datum.

The datum seating represents the specified datum feature.

An indicator traverses the other face at known height.

Stable support limits rocking and distortion.

Working:sequence and reason

Seat the datum face as required and establish the reference.

Traverse the inspected face in the specified direction.

Correct reference/setup effects and evaluate the specified zone.

For a simple straight face,estimate a small slope byDelta/h,stating the approximation.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A.020mm change over100mm implies slope.0002rad≈.01146° in a simple setup;this is not a universal substitute for full surface-zone evaluation.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Squareness90° orientation તપાસે;perpendicularity drawing મુજબ zoneવાળો datum-related control છે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Qualified square/reference કે CMM datum સામે90° આપે.

Datum seating આપેલા datum featureનું representation કરે.

Indicator જાણીતી height પર બીજી face traverse કરે.

Stable support rocking/distortion ઘટાડે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Datum face યોગ્ય બેસાડી reference લો.

Inspected faceને આપેલી દિશામાં traverse કરો.

Reference/setup effects સુધારી specified zone તપાસો.

Simple straight face માટે small slope Delta/hથી અંદાજો અને approximation જણાવો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Simple setupમાં100mm પર.020mm ફેરફાર એટલે slope.0002rad≈.01146°;આ full surface-zone evaluationનો universal વિકલ્પ નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A CMM measures spatial coordinates with a probe and evaluates specified dimensions/geometrical features from them.

Construction:parts and purpose

A table/structure supports the part and motion system.

Three coordinate axes have position measurement systems.

A contact/scanning/optical probe senses the feature.

Controller/software handles motion,alignment and evaluation.

Reference artefacts,probe qualification and environmental control support reliable work.

Working:sequence and reason

Interpret the drawing,datum system and measurement strategy.

Fixture without distortion and qualify the probe as required.

Establish coordinate alignment from the specified datums.

Acquire enough well-distributed points with safe,verified motion.

Fit/evaluate the features with the required algorithm;report deviation,uncertainty and decision rule.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A CMM result depends on probing,alignment,sampling,temperature and evaluation algorithm;software output alone is not proof of conformity.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

CMM probeથી spatial coordinates માપી તેમાંથી specified dimensions/geometrical features evaluate કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Table/structure part અને motion systemને ટેકો આપે.

ત્રણ coordinate axesમાં position measurement systems હોય.

Contact/scanning/optical probe feature શોધે.

Controller/software motion,alignment,evaluation કરે.

Reference artefacts,probe qualification અને environmental control reliability આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Drawing,datum system,measurement strategy સમજો.

Distortion વગર fixture કરી probe qualify કરો.

Specified datumsથી coordinate alignment કરો.

Safe,verified motionથી પૂરતા અને distributed points લો.

જરૂરી algorithmથી features evaluate કરી deviation,uncertainty,decision rule આપો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

CMM result probing,alignment,sampling,temperature,algorithm પર આધારિત છે;software output એકલું conformityનો પુરાવો નથી.

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. Define the tolerance,sketch the zone,identify any datum,and explain reference/support/probe/reading reduction.
  2. For fits,tabulate all four limits,calculate signed extreme clearances,classify,then state allowance and units.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Keep form error,orientation error,size error and run-out separate;one reading does not establish all four.

Quick check: Does flatness need a datum?

No.The form tolerance is self-contained;the measurement still needs a qualified reference/method.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Tolerance define કરો,zone દોરો,જરૂરી datum બતાવો અને reference/support/probe/reading reduction સમજાવો.
  2. Fits માટે ચારેય limitsનું table બનાવો,signed extreme clearances ગણો,classify કરો અને allowance,units આપો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Form error,orientation error,size error,run-out જુદા રાખો;એક reading ચારેય સાબિત કરતી નથી.

જાતે વિચારો: Flatness માટે Datum જોઈએ?

ના.Form tolerance self-contained છે;માપવા qualified reference/method તો જોઈએ.

terms.en: Use signed clearances;state the setup and approximation for slope.
terms.gu: Signed clearances લો;Slope માટે setup અને approximation આપો.

a.en: Both clearance and interference are possible.
Two concentric circles in a section.
To relate coordinates to the specified datum system.
a.gu: Coordinatesને specified datum system સાથે જોડવા.
